long_biography.plain_text:
Water systems provided the practical foundation for Sayyah Mohd Moosa Al Qubaisi's business career. Michael Daly, then a BP training manager, identified the young Al Qubaisi as a future partner. Al Qubaisi later joined the business that became Bin Moosa & Daly, combining local partnership with plumbing materials, pumping systems and technical services across the UAE.

Al Qubaisi created Bin Moosa Group as an investment and management platform rather than a single operating company. Its structure lets subsidiaries run independently while the parent sets direction, develops partnerships and supplies financial backing. Bin Moosa & Daly continues to trade in pumps, water systems and related engineering services from branches across the Emirates.
